explanations.3: This tells PHP to require strict type checking, so if you pass the wrong type to a function, it will error instead of trying to convert it.
explanations.18: The preg_replace function uses a regex pattern to find anything that isn't a letter or number, and replaces each group of those characters with a single dash.
explanations.19: After replacing special characters with dashes, we trim any leftover dashes from the start and end (the cast to string is just a safety measure for type checking).
